A multipurpose oil that promotes healthy skin and hair. It helps with dryness, reduces redness & irritation, promotes healing & skin regeneration plus so much more. We won’t bore you here but if you want to learn more, read more about it in this blog! 

Intention Til the Last Drop

This oil is made with care thanks to the local Malang, Indonesia community where we source our tamanu oil. It’s 100% traceable and sustainable, and with our partnership with Women’s Earth Alliance, each purchase made supports the women farmers that helped this product come to life! Welcome the healing benefits of tamanu oil while empowering the people behind the scenes.

products.title: Beet The Sun SPF 40 PA+++
products.body_html:
A lightweight chemical sunscreen that's made to look and feel like your skin. Supercharged with Beetroot Extract — a powerful antioxidant that gives your skin additional protection against oxidative stress — this SPF defends against the sun and other environmental aggressors without any extra drama or a white cast. 

  • Why is it different: Offers seamless yet hydrating sun protection for any skin tone without a white cast or leaving skin feeling greasy.
  • Helps with: Defending the skin against the sun and other environmental aggressors.
  • Made for: All skin types.
  • Clinically Proven:
    • Provides SPF 40 Broad Spectrum protection. 
    • Based on clinical tests conducted at two independent facilities.
  • Please note, our Beet the Sun SPF packaging is currently being updated on a rolling basis.

products.title: Double Cleanse
products.body_html:
Makeup Re-Wined Jelly Oil Cleanser & Matcha Hemp Hydrating Cleanser are inseparable when it comes to a barrier-friendly double cleansing routine. Use Makeup Re-Wined to gently wash away any oil-based impurities like makeup or sunscreen, and then follow up with Matcha Hemp Hydrating Cleanser to remove any leftover residue for a clean that leaves your skin hydrated and supple.

  • Why is it different: This unstoppable duo is proven to deeply cleanse your skin while never leaving it stripped of moisture.
  • Helps with: Removing dirt, grime, makeup, SPF, and anything else the world throws at you and your skin.
  • Made for: All skin types
  • Includes:
    • 1 full-size Makeup Re-Wined (100ml/3.38 fl oz)
    • 1 full-size Matcha Hemp Hydrating Cleanser (120 ml/4.05 fl oz)

products.title: Makeup Re-Wined
products.body_html:
A gentle jelly-to-oil cleanser to dissolve makeup, sunscreen, and impurities with our sustainably-sourced, upcycled Grapeseed Oil. Reveal clean, nourished skin as you melt away the day. 

  • Why is it different: Transforms from a jelly-like texture to a milky oil to provide fun, but mess-free cleansing.
  • Helps with: Makeup removal or oil cleansing while keeping your skin barrier healthy.
  • Made for: All skin types.
  • Clinically proven: Safe for sensitive skin.
    • Based on an independent study of 30 participants with sensitive skin.

featured_image.alt: Makeup Re-Wined - Transforming jelly oil cleanser. #size_3.38 oz / 100 ml

products.title: Great Body Relief
products.body_html:
A light, pillowy body lotion that soothes sensitivity and restores your skin. Formulated with skin-healing Tamanu Oil to soothe, Fermented Oil Blend to condition and Ceramides to strengthen skin barrier. Deeply moisturize your skin without leaving a greasy residue. 

  • Why is it different: Easily sinks into the skin without leaving a greasy after-feel.
  • Helps with: Clearing the skin’s surface and repairing your skin barrier from head to toe with essential Ceramides.
  • Made for: All skin types especially dry, sensitive body skin.
  • Clinically proven:
    • After one use: Kept skin moisturized for 24 hours.
    • After one week: Improved damaged skin barrier function.
    • Based on an independent clinical study on 22 participants with dry skin.

featured_image.alt: Great Body Relief - Smooth, reparative body lotion.

products.title: Oat So Simple Water Cream
products.body_html:
A calming lightweight moisturizer with a burst of hydration. The light-as-water texture cools sensitive areas and Oat Extract protects against irritants to provide comforting relief to oversensitized areas.

  • Why is it different: Made with only 9 ingredients to hydrate parched, easily sensitized skin.
  • Helps with: Sealing in moisture and preventing further water loss from the skin. 
  • Made for: All skin types, especially sensitive skin.
  • Clinically Proven: After one use, the moisturizer was shown to improve skin’s hydration for up to 48 hours.
    Based on an independent clinical study of 21 subjects.

featured_image.alt: Oat So Simple Water Cream - Basic, lightweight moisturizer. #size_Jar - 80 mL

products.title: Great Barrier Relief
products.body_html:
This reparative serum helps soothe and restore your skin barrier while calming redness and irritations. Infused with 10% Tamanu Oil to nurse your skin back to health, Great Barrier Relief is perfect for resetting and providing TLC for over-exfoliated or irritated skin. 

  • Why is it different: Restores and gently moisturizes over-sensitized skin without leaving a greasy after-feel. 
  • Helps with: Repairing and strengthening your skin barrier so it can protect you from environmental aggressors and eczema flare-ups.
  • Made for: All skin types but especially sensitive, eczema-prone skin.
  • Clinically Proven: Improves damaged skin barrier function after 2 weeks of use.
    • Based on an independent clinical study on 20 participants.
  • Bonus: Our packaging allows you to use up every last drop!
    • Please note, our packaging is currently being updated on a rolling basis.

featured_image.alt: Kravebea bottle of Great Barrier Relief on a teal background

products.title: Matcha Hemp Hydrating Cleanser
products.body_html:
A gentle, nourishing cleanser that restores hydration and antioxidants to the skin. Matcha, rich in free radical-fighting antioxidants, paired with Hemp Seed Oil to deeply moisturize and strengthen the skin barrier. Effectively cleanses without leaving a dry, tight feeling.

  • Why is it different: Gently cleanses without leaving skin stripped.
  • Helps with: Maintaining a healthy skin barrier by leaving the natural lipids and oils your skin needs.
  • Made for: All skin types but especially dry, sensitive skin.
  • Clinically Proven: 48 hours of increased skin moisture capacity after one use.
    Based on an independent clinical study of 22 subjects.
  • Please note, our packaging is currently being updated on a rolling basis.

products.title: Kale-Lalu-yAHA
products.body_html:
A gentle yet effective exfoliator that smooths texture, fades discoloration, and unclogs pores. Powered by 5.25% Glycolic Acid, Kale-Lalu-yAHA supports skin renewal while preserving barrier health. Supported with hydrating Hyaluronic Acid and boost of antioxidants and vitamins from Kale, Spinach, and Parsley. 

  • Why is it different: Features a gentle (but still effective!) level of exfoliating acid that even sensitive skin can love.
  • Helps with: Fading hyperpigmentation, unclogging pores, and dissolving dead skin cells
  • Made for: All skin types but especially dull, sensitive skin.
  • Clinically proven: Safe for sensitive skin. 
    • Based on an independent clinical study on 30 participants with sensitive skin.
  • Tips:
    • Start incorporating into your routine slowly and gradually build use to 2-3x per week or as needed. Don't forget to follow up with sunscreen in the mornings!

featured_image.alt: Kale-Lalu-yAHA - Gentle AHA exfoliator #size_6.76 fl oz / 200 ml
